games.name: [👑 UPD 0.5 👥] Anime Overload!
games.desc:
The world of Anime Overload awaits you!🌟 

Upon a scientific discovery to link this world to others, to summon in "Heroes," a glitch occurs... ⚠️The world as we know it changed in an instant. games.name: [⚡] Arcane Conquest
games.desc:
⚔️ Explore, craft, conquer! 🛠️

🔥 Complete Quests and Achievements to earn loot, XP, Arcanium, and other special rewards!
📆 3 Daily Quests per day & 5 Weekly Quests per week, scaled to your level.
🏆 9 Achievements, each with numerous tiers to complete & rewards to obtain!
💎 15 new cosmetics & 4 bonus skill points to obtain through high-tier achievements!

Fight your way through the mystical Corrupted Forest, interdimensional Abyssal Gates, and frigid Frostbound Crypt, vanquishing bosses and looting valuable items to improve your power. Upgrade your gear from Common to Fabled in this RPG dungeon crawler as you master five unique classes, each with their own strengths and roles! Forge your own personalized playstyle as you fill out the Skill Tree and craft powerful items to aid your conquest. Collect hundreds of unique weapons, armor sets, spells, and more as you make your way to the top of the leaderboards!

Will you be the first to drop a Mythical?
